recognition: Cartographic classification in Natural Earth: Sovereign country. This classification is not a statement of international recognition.
provenance: Country facts are from the archived CIA World Factbook mirror. Officeholders and economic/military data are reference observations, not a live update.
capital: Seoul · Sejong, located some 120 km (75 mi) south of Seoul, serves as an administrative capital for segments of the South Korean government
rulers: President LEE Jae-myung (since 4 June 2025); Prime Minister KIM Min-seok (since 3 July 2025)
economy: high-income, export- and technology-oriented East Asian economy; manufacturing led by semiconductor and automotive industries; slow growth amid declining construction investment, export risks, and recent political instability; aging workforce; increased restraint in fiscal policy while maintaining industry support initiatives GDP (PPP): $2.607 trillion (2023 est.). note: data in 2021 dollars
military: Armed Forces of the Republic of Korea: Republic of Korea Army (ROKA), Republic of Korea Navy (ROKN, includes Marine Corps, ROKMC), Republic of Korea Air Force (ROKAF) Ministry of Maritime Affairs and Fisheries: Korea Coast Guard; Ministry of Interior and Safety: Korean National Police Agency… (2025) Expenditure: 2.3% of GDP (2025 est.)
asOf: Archived Factbook edition; individual figures retain their stated years.
